extracted.intended_audience: researchers conducting systematic reviews; librarians and students involved in evidence synthesis
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for performing quality assessment (risk of bias) of individual studies included in a systematic review, including timing, purpose, and recommended appraisal tools tailored to study design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing of quality assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Once screening (article selection) is completed, the Quality Assessment part of the systematic review process may begin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality assessment may be performed before or after data extraction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess methodological quality of included studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Since systematic reviews rely on data from other studies, the evidence in a systematic review is only as good as, or as free from bias as, the included studies. Therefore, the methodological quality of each individual study included in a systematic review should be assessed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This process involves appraising, judging, and documenting potential risks of bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and goals of critical appraisal
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical appraisal of scientific studies is important because it helps assess the trustworthiness, relevance, and quality of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Critical appraisal aids in distinguishing between strong and weak studies, reducing information overload and bias in clinical practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use design-specific critical appraisal tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Each study should be appraised using a critical appraisal tool specific to each study design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For help in deciding which risk of bias / quality assessment tool(s) to use for each study design, consult the listed resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation: use Covidence
rubrics_metrics.description: We recommend that you use Covidence to conduct quality assessment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covidence provides features to support quality assessment as part of the systematic review workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: LATITUDES Network tool selector
rubrics_metrics.description: Select a study design using the drop-down menu, and matching appraisal tools will be listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the LATITUDES Network selector to find appraisal tools appropriate to a given study design.

rubrics_metrics.name: CASP Checklists
rubrics_metrics.description: Appraisal checklists for each study design, by the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CASP provides checklists tailored to study designs (RCTs, cohort, case-control, etc.) to guide critical appraisal.

rubrics_metrics.name: JBI Critical Appraisal Tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Appraisal checklists for each study design, by the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: JBI checklists offer design-specific items to assess methodological quality across multiple study types.

rubrics_metrics.name: OSF Quality Assessment and Risk of Bias Tool Repository
rubrics_metrics.description: Download the spreadsheet named, 'Repository of Quality Assessment and Risk of Bias Tools OSF.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Study Type/Intended Use' dropdown menu in column F to find recommended tools based on study design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cochrane Risk of Bias (ROB) 2.0 Tool
rubrics_metrics.description: Templates are tailored to randomized parallel-group trials, cluster-randomized parallel-group trials (including stepped-wedge designs), and randomized cross-over trials and other matched designs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ROB 2.0 for assessing risk of bias in randomized trials with templates specific to trial design.

rubrics_metrics.name: CASP - Randomized Controlled Trial Appraisal Tool
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist for RCTs created by the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this CASP checklist to assess key methodological and reporting features of randomized trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: JBI Checklist for Randomized Controlled Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: A critical appraisal checklist from the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) for randomized controlled trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply JBI RCT checklist items to evaluate internal validity and risk of bias in RCTs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS) for nonrandomised studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Validated tool for assessing case-control and cohort studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the NOS to assess selection, comparability, and exposure/outcome domains in nonrandomized studies included in meta-analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: CASP - Cohort Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist created by the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) to assess key criteria relevant to cohort studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CASP cohort checklist items to evaluate bias and methodological conduct in cohort designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: JBI Checklist for Cohort Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist for cohort studies from the Joanna Briggs Institute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the JBI cohort checklist to systematically appraise cohort study quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: STROBE Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist for quality assessment of case-control, cohort, and cross-sectional studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use STROBE as guidance for reporting and for elements relevant to assessing methodological quality in observational studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: CASP - Case Control Study
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist created by the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme (CASP) to assess key criteria relevant to case-control studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use CASP case-control checklist items to evaluate selection, measurement, and bias concerns specific to case-control studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tool to Assess Risk of Bias in Case Control Studies (CLARITY Group)
rubrics_metrics.description: A quality assessment tool for case-control studies from the CLARITY Group at McMaster University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the CLARITY Group tool to systematically judge risk of bias in case-control designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: JBI Checklist for Case-Control Studies
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist created by the Joanna Briggs Institute for case-control studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the JBI case-control checklist to assess methodological and reporting quality specific to case-control designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool (MMAT)
rubrics_metrics.description: The MMAT is intended to be used as a checklist for concomitantly appraising and/or describing studies included in systematic mixed studies reviews (reviews including original qualitative, quantitative, and mixed methods studies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use MMAT when a review includes a mix of qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods primary studies to appraise across paradigms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality assessment with diverse studies (QuADS) tool
rubrics_metrics.description: QuADS is an appraisal tool for methodological and reporting quality in systematic reviews of mixed- or multi-method studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use QuADS to assess methodological and reporting quality in reviews that include heterogeneous study types and methods.
